title: Human-AI Interaction Alignment: Designing, Evaluating, and Evolving Value-Centered AI For Reciprocal Human-AI Futures
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is on the general alignment of AI with human and societal values.
